data.title: Bitcoin to $10,000 a 'Faustian Bargain': Bloomberg's Top Strategist Updates BTC Price Outlook
data.description: Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Commodity Strategist Mike McGlone has updated his medium-term Bitcoin forecast, warning investors about the risk of a major price correction.
